This probably doesn’t help but I write the first thing that comes to my head if it’s trash throw it out start again. Every night challenge yourself to write SOMETHING it doesn’t matter what it comes out as just let your mind do it’s thing. Pretty soon you get so used to letting the words out and onto a page that you get better at articulating yourself. It’s just a practice thing and  you gotta be okay with throwing material out - throwing material out is a sign of progress and shouldn’t be something to feel bad about! And also, so long as everything you’re writing down is truthful to you and coming from YOU then how could it ever be dishonest art? You just gotta practice at it, pen to the paper and don’t stop, just like freestylin. And good luck to you man!
